title: Login error messages distinguish unknown username from wrong password
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/session.js:85 returns 'Invalid username' and :94 'Invalid password', distinct messages (no evidence cited, checked source directly).

title: Login attempts logged without repudiation-resistant records or CRLF encoding
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/session.js:64 console.logs the raw userName with no CRLF encoding and stdout is the only record (no evidence cited, checked source directly).

title: Swig autoescape disabled lets stored profile and memo data render as executable HTML in the app's views
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: misclassified
reason: Real (server.js:137 sets autoescape:false and app/views/profile.html:45-66 echo stored fields) but XSS is A05 Injection in OWASP 2025, not A03 Software Supply Chain.

title: Unauthenticated MongoDB wire traffic carrying the users collection can be read or rewritten on the container network
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: docker-compose.yml:8 uses a credential-free mongodb://mongo:27017 URI and :16-17 exposes 27017 to the compose network with no auth or TLS (no evidence cited, checked source).

title: Any logged-in employee can read the full employee roster and edit any user's benefit start date via /benefits
evidenceLocations: ev-gap-1: app/routes/index.js:63 | ev-route-12: app/routes/index.js:55 | ev-route-13: app/routes/index.js:56
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/index.js:55-56 guard /benefits with isLoggedIn only and the isAdmin fix at :57-60 is commented out; ev-gap-1 at :63 describes /allocations not /benefits so it does not count.

title: Missing security response headers allow the benefits admin page to be framed and its markup abused
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: predicted_correct
reason: Gap only and really missing: helmet is a dependency at package.json:16 but server.js:10 comments out the require and :45 the frameguard call, so no frame-protection header is set.

title: Contribution upsert keyed by an unparsed userId can be steered to another user's document
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: unsupported
reason: The userId comes from req.session at app/routes/contributions.js:43, set server-side at session.js:116, so an attacker cannot steer the upsert filter at contributions-dao.js:28; index.js:52 only shows the route.

title: Error responses are returned over cleartext HTTP, exposing the session cookie and leaked internals on the wire
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: server.js:145 starts a plain http server (the https block at :150-155 is commented out) and app/routes/error.js:10-12 renders the error object into the response (no evidence cited).

title: Unpinned and outdated CI actions allow tampering with the GitHub Actions CI pipeline
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: misclassified
reason: Real: .github/workflows/e2e-test.yml:16, :21 and :26 use checkout@v2, setup-node@v1 and cache@v2 by mutable tag, but this is A03 Software Supply Chain or A08 in OWASP 2025, not A06 Insecure Design.

title: Loss of the MongoDB link takes down memo reads and writes with no degradation path
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: too_generic
reason: A single database going away taking its reads and writes with it is true of any web app; app/routes/memos.js:25-26 just forwards the DAO error to next(err) like every other handler.

title: Missing security response headers let the echoed /research body run without any CSP restraint
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: predicted_correct
reason: Gap only and really missing: app/routes/research.js:18-25 writes the fetched body as text/html and server.js:51 leaves helmet.contentSecurityPolicy commented out, so no CSP header exists.

title: Session fixation: login does not regenerate the session id before setting req.session.userId
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/session.js:116 sets req.session.userId without calling req.session.regenerate (the fix is only described in the comment at :112-115); the cited index.js:34 is the POST /login route.

title: No authentication or audit trail on login attempts makes credential-stuffing against /login unattributable
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/session.js:90-98 handles a wrong password with no log line and :116-117 logs nothing on success, so only unknown-user attempts (:64) leave any trace; index.js:34 is the route.

title: Stored XSS through memo content rendered as raw Markdown HTML in app/views/memos.html
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: unsupported
reason: The claim assumes marked runs unsanitised, but server.js:126-128 sets marked sanitize:true before app/views/memos.html:31 calls marked(doc.memo), so the stated mechanism is wrong.

title: Arbitrary local file read via vulnerable swig@1.4.2 template rendering (CVE-2023-25345)
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: unsupported
reason: The OSV item is accurate (package.json:22 swig ^1.4.2) but no render path takes user input: app/routes/tutorial.js:31-33 iterates the fixed page list at :15-28, so arbitrary file read is not reachable.

title: Missing security response headers let injected markup run in the login and signup pages
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: misclassified
reason: The gap is real (server.js:10 and :51 leave helmet and CSP commented out; session.js:83 echoes userName into login.html:110 unescaped) but missing headers are A02 Security Misconfiguration, not A05 Injection.

title: Any logged-in employee can read the full roster and rewrite any employee's benefit start date via /benefits
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: confirmed_useful
reason: Real: app/routes/index.js:55-56 register GET and POST /benefits behind isLoggedIn only and benefits-dao.js:24 updates any _id from req.body; duplicates threat-22.

title: Cross-site request forgery forces a victim's contribution update, reaching the eval() sink
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: predicted_correct
reason: Gap only and really missing: server.js:107-112 leaves csurf commented out and app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval() the posted fields, so a cross-site POST reaches the sink; index.js:34 is the login route the gap cites.

title: Unauthenticated, uncached tutorial page rendering can be used to exhaust the single Node process
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: too_generic
reason: app/routes/tutorial.js:8 and :31 are plain res.render calls of static pages; an unauthenticated page being requestable in a loop is true of any web app.

title: Open redirect on GET /learn reached over the zap-to-app flow
notes: second labeller; see label and reason columns
label: predicted_correct
reason: Gap only and really missing: app/routes/index.js:72 does res.redirect(req.query.url) with no validation of the url read at :70; the ZAP proxy component is a mislabel but the redirect is real.
